instruction: Cinematic stage photograph, full shot. On an indoor theater stage with a dark teal backdrop featuring white snowflakes and 'CENTRO TOLZU' text, two ballet dancers perform. In the foreground, the female ballet dancer in a pink tutu and tiara (R2) balances on one pointe shoe, her right leg bent and raised, looking forward. Behind her, the male ballet dancer in a red long-sleeved top and white tights (R1) stands supporting her, his raised right hand holding her raised right hand. Cool stage lighting illuminates the performers, casting soft shadows, highlighting the teal and pink color palette.
